audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer field tracked an ability called 'Repeating Dashes'. Ambessa has no such ability — the entry never named a single real one.
audit.why: Her kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). The decisive interaction was also absent: Drakehound's Step only arms while she is casting an ability, so Feral Scream's silence stops the dash from existing rather than merely punishing it — the Ambessa-side audit reaches the same conclusion from her direction. Second interaction never stated: Repudiation deals increased damage if she blocked non-minion damage while bracing, so Vorpal Spikes autos into the brace actively feed her slam.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream silences the cast, so Drakehound's Step never arms; never spike her through Repudiation's brace.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appeared anywhere; spikes were pinned to the invented 'Repeating Dashes'.
audit.why: Cunning Sweep is 14/13/12/11/10s, Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9s, Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s, Public Execution 130/115/100s. Feast at 80s against her 130s ultimate is the scaling argument the page was trying and failing to make.
audit.corrected: Spikes keyed to Q at 14s falling to 10s, W at 18s, and Feast 80s versus Public Execution 130s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart and the prose disagree about levels 2-3: win[1] and win[2] both say Cho'Gath, while whys[2] says 'this is her cleanest window and she owns it' and spikes[0] is titled 'Ambessa's window'.
audit.why: The packet level chart gives level 3 to Ambessa; the Ambessa-side audit gives it to Cho'Gath. Two sources, opposite answers, and my own page contradicts itself. Flipping the enum would break the mirror; rewriting the prose would erase a power shift I cannot verify. Left alone and escalated rather than guessed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned the Drakehound's Step wind-up.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json flags it as an auto-attack reset tell — the empowered attack, not the ability cast, is the cue to step back. Also flags Ambessa as a needs-antiheal matchup via Public Execution's heal.

notes: focus.text is still the invented 'Ambessa Repeating Dashes' but it is 24 characters, under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so it cannot be corrected through a proposal. It needs a hand edit to 'Ambessa Drakehound's Step' — the fabricated name is currently the headline on this matchup's loading screen. Following the Ambessa-side audit, I made no grounding claim for Rupture: the kit file flags grounding on Q but Riot's description is only knockup plus slow, and the same file flags grounding on Repudiation and Public Execution with nothing in Riot's text to support it. The silence-stops-Drakehound's-Step point is a deduction from the two Riot descriptions together, matching how the mirror stated it. Tenacity versus her suppression is not in the data and I claimed nothing.
